description: Phase 2 - Fresh competitor deep-dive. Re-verify every rival the repo already tracks with current dates/commit SHAs, RESOLVE every user-named rival, FIND new rivals (the user notes many keep appearing), and for anything borrowable capture runtime/HLD/LLD + the exact source-file URLs with LICENSE notes so code can be lifted later. Update the FIVE existing competitor owner docs in place (COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md, VIABILITY-VS-COMPETITORS.md, COMPETITOR-PROMOTED-USE-CASES.md, REFERENCE-IMPLEMENTATIONS.md, REFERENCE-REPOS-CORE-ARCHITECTURE-INDEX.md) rather than creating parallel duplicates; create a new doc only if no owner exists for a concept. Depends on FEAT-001 (branch). Independent of FEAT-002; both feed FEAT-004.
steps: Work on branch docs/audit-competitor-superset. Read the five competitor owner docs plus docs/OPENBOT-REFERENCE-IMPLEMENTATION-STUDY.md, docs/DESKTOP-REFERENCE-IMPLEMENTATION-AUDIT.md, docs/ZCODE-UI-INSPIRATION-AUDIT.md and CURRENT-RUN.md's 'Pending research' section so you update existing rows in place and honor the naming-collision discipline the repo already maintains.

Resolve and research each USER-NAMED rival with free web search + web fetch (network is open): Claude Code desktop at https://code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop/ - reconcile whether it is a distinct/newer surface vs the already-documented 'Claude Cowork' (support.claude.com) and research it fresh; OpenWork = https://github.com/different-ai/openwork; Open Cowork = https://github.com/opencoworkai/open-cowork; ZCode desktop = zai-org/ZCode (app path packages/desktop, Apache-2.0); DeepSeek Harness = deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness (app path apps/desktop, MIT) - note desktop pin may be stale (0.2.2-alpha.2 -> 0.2.2-rc.1); OpenAI dots (distinct from OpenDot/opendot.live=athulsreekumar/opendot, from CopilotKit/OpenDots, and from composio-community/open-dot - PRESERVE this collision discipline; dots model now reported GPT-6.1 Terra); Muse assistant = Meta Muse; OpenBot = nightly-labs/openbot (PolyForm Noncommercial - reference/UX study ONLY, no commercial code reuse, flag this) and note the separate CopilotKit/openbot collision; Grok bot = xAI Grok Bots (vendor rebrand SpaceXSI bundles Cursor). Also fold in the already-verified-but-unapplied correction that Claude Duet is a distinct rival absent from docs/specs, and that ChatGPT Work evidence moved to learn.chatgpt.com (help.openai.com 403s).

For each GitHub-backed rival, clone shallow into repo_take/ which is gitignored (line 38 of .gitignore): git clone --depth 1 <url> repo_take/<name>; record the EXACT resolved commit SHA (git -C repo_take/<name> rev-parse HEAD) and the clone date. NEVER stage repo_take/ content; NEVER clone the LiteCowork repo. If a clone fails or the repo is private/nonexistent, fall back to vendor docs/SDK/README/Reddit use-case threads and record source+date+observed fact+limitation. For products with no public repo (Claude Code desktop, OpenAI dots, Meta Muse, Grok), rely on documentation/SDK/announcements and mark evidence source accordingly.

Find NEW rivals beyond the named set via web search (local-first/desktop AI coworker/agent apps - e.g. category entrants that keep appearing) and add any genuinely comparable ones with the same evidence discipline. Do not invent products; only add ones you can confirm as real with a cited source.

Capture for each rival: what a user can ACTUALLY do today (feature surface), the runtime/HLD (process model, IPC, persistence, agent loop) and LLD where a repo is available, and for anything borrowable the EXACT file URL(s) (blob URL at the pinned SHA) plus the LICENSE and a copy/prototype/reject verdict per LiteCowork invariants. Respect LICENSE: PolyForm Noncommercial / Elastic / SUL = reference/UX study only (no code reuse), MIT/Apache = permissive with attribution.

Apply all findings into the existing owner docs IN PLACE, following each file's own evidence rules and format: update per-rival verified-behavior tables + primary-source URLs in docs/COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md; update per-competitor TARGET/PARTIAL/DEFER-V2/RESEARCH/NO verdicts and allocate new research gates from RV-13 upward in docs/VIABILITY-VS-COMPETITORS.md; extend UC-xx rows in docs/COMPETITOR-PROMOTED-USE-CASES.md (follow its semantic-suffix UC-ID convention); update the pinned REF-* matrix with new SHAs, app paths, copy/prototype/reject verdicts and LICENSE notes in docs/REFERENCE-IMPLEMENTATIONS.md; update the read-first architecture/IPC/persistence/agent-loop file lists per rival in docs/REFERENCE-REPOS-CORE-ARCHITECTURE-INDEX.md. Refresh each doc's 'Updated'/'checked' date and record every stale->fresh version/SHA correction (DeepSeek, ZCode 3.17.1->3.17.2, dots model, Grok rebrand) under that doc's rules. Do NOT rewrite historical dates to make a capability look earlier.

Mark upfront as blocked (retryable false) any rival that cannot be verified as a real public product after a genuine web search, recording the attempt and the gap rather than fabricating. Add Claude Duet as a tracked rival.

Run the doc gates (markdown, owner-consistency), update CURRENT-RUN.md's 'Pending research' section in place to mark the competitive corrections applied, and commit on the feature branch with a message like 'docs(competitors): phase 2 fresh rival re-verification, SHAs/runtimes/borrowable URLs, RV-13..'.
acceptance_criteria: Every user-named rival is resolved to either a confirmed public repo (with cloned repo_take/<name> + exact HEAD SHA recorded) or a documented no-repo product with cited vendor/SDK/doc evidence and date; Claude Code desktop vs Claude Cowork is explicitly reconciled; the OpenDot/dots/OpenBot naming collisions are preserved with distinct identities.

The five existing competitor owner docs are updated IN PLACE (no parallel duplicate competitor doc is created) with: fresh checked dates, corrected stale versions/SHAs (DeepSeek desktop pin, ZCode 3.17.1->3.17.2, dots GPT-6.1 Terra, Grok/SpaceXSI), per-rival feature surface, runtime/HLD/LLD notes, and exact borrowable-file URLs with LICENSE + copy/prototype/reject verdicts.

New research gates are allocated from RV-13 upward in VIABILITY-VS-COMPETITORS.md and any new UC rows follow the existing UC-ID semantic-suffix convention; OpenBot borrowable items are flagged PolyForm-Noncommercial reference-only (no code reuse).

Claude Duet is added as a tracked rival; at least one genuine attempt to find NEW rivals is recorded; any unverifiable named product is marked blocked (retryable false) with the attempt documented rather than fabricated.
repo_take/ clones are present but NOT staged (verify git status shows them ignored); the LiteCowork repo was not re-cloned.
verification: Run python3 scripts/audit_v1_markdown.py and confirm 0 broken relative links after the competitor-doc edits.
Run python3 scripts/validate_design_owner_consistency.py and confirm 0 issues (no duplicate competitor owner created).

For each cloned rival run git -C repo_take/<name> rev-parse HEAD and confirm the SHA matches what the docs record; run `git status --porcelain repo_take` and confirm repo_take/ is ignored (no staged entries).
grep VIABILITY-VS-COMPETITORS.md for RV-13 and COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md for the refreshed checked date and the corrected version strings; confirm borrowable entries carry a blob URL + LICENSE note.
